items.author: Trump
items.text: The Market is down more than 6 Trillion Dollars since the Democrats’ rather strange “win” on November 3rd. NASDAQ, by itself, is down 20%. This is 100% due to the fact that the Democrats are “BAD” due to their Anti Growth, and Retribution Only, Policies, and worse. If they don't change, FAST, it will only get worse. But fear not, our Country will soon be STRONG AGAIN — Lots of good things happening! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称民主党胜选以来美股市值蒸发逾6万亿美元、纳斯达克跌约20%，并猛烈抨击民主党政策。

items.author: Trump
items.text: As everyone remembers, I predicted two things concerning the November 3rd Midterm Elections. One, that if the Democrats win, the Stock Markets would go down, substantially, which they have, and two, that the Islamic Republic of Iran, which has killed 81,000 protestors as of today, will grow more aggressive in their attacks, which has also occurred. Iran has launched more drones and missiles in the last week than at any time for over a year. Don’t worry, they’ve all been knocked down, and done no damage. Iranian leaders consider the Democrats weak, ineffective, and Country destroying, but I won
items.summary_cn: 特朗普将民主党胜选后股市下跌归因于其反增长政策，并警告伊朗可能加大导弹和无人机攻击。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Isn’t it interesting that Oil prices have dropped precipitously after the Midterm Elections? I said that was going to happen. The whole thing is a Giant Hoax! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称中期选举后油价已大幅下跌，并认为这验证了其此前的判断。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: US House unconstitutionally passed spending bill in 2022, court rules
items.summary_cn: 据报道，美国法院裁定众议院在2022年通过支出法案的程序违宪，涉及政府支出与财政政策不确定性。
